name: T3 Code Assistant
tagline: T3 and phone messages on Even G2
description: A shared Even G2 dashboard for T3 Code and Android notifications. Read messages, dictate and review replies, and dismiss notifications through your private computer bridge and Android companion.
author: Daenon Janis

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connect to your authenticated private dashboard bridge.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Dictate T3 messages and replies to Android notifications.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Use approximate phone location for dashboard weather.
